loading.title: Loading
loading.message: Fetching data from the AI Factory API.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.message: There is no data to show for this view.

error.network: No connection to the AI Factory API. Check the base URL and whether the service is running.
error.authentication: An operational key is required for this area.
error.forbidden: Access to this resource is not permitted.
error.validation: The request was rejected as invalid.
error.notFound: The requested resource no longer exists.
error.conflict: The resource changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
error.providerFailure: An external service or provider is temporarily unavailable.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Updates are being slowed down.
error.server: The server reported an unexpected error.

appearance.languageHint: Applies immediately, without restarting the application.

connection.hint: Configured at build time with --dart-define. Editing from the UI arrives in a later phase.

validation.nameTooLong: The project name cannot exceed 200 characters.
validation.nameInvalidCharacters: The project name cannot contain “..” or any of < > : " / \ | ? *
validation.descriptionRequired: A description is required. The Factory plans against it, and a project without one cannot be started.
validation.repositoryRequired: A repository URL is required for a Git source.

needsAttention.title: Needs attention
needsAttention.subtitle: Projects waiting for a human decision, failed projects, and projects the backend recorded an error for.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Counted by this client from the full project list the API returns.

platform.title: Platform
platform.subtitle: The state of the AI Factory service itself. It says nothing about whether a project succeeded.
platform.noCycleYet: No cycle run since the service started.
platform.operationalKeyRequired: Agent run counters require an operational key, which this client cannot supply yet. Entering one arrives in a later phase.
platform.workerHealthNote: The API exposes no worker health endpoint. Scheduler activity above is the nearest available signal, and it is activity rather than health.

partial.title: Some information could not be loaded
partial.message: The project data below is complete. One or more platform sources did not answer, so their tiles show no value.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.message: Create a project to give the Factory something to work on.

noMatches.title: No project matches this filter
noMatches.message: There are projects, but none of them match what you are filtering for.

unpaged.title: Large project list
unpaged.message: The API returns all {} projects in one response — it has no paging. Filter to keep this screen fast.

create.title: New project
create.name: Name
create.nameHelp: Also used to name the workspace folder.
create.descriptionHelp: What should be built. The Factory plans against this text, and a project without it cannot be started.
create.sourceHelp: How the project workspace is set up. This is a separate backend step and can be retried on its own.
create.sourceGitHelp: Clone an existing repository into the workspace.
create.branchHelp: Optional. The repository default is used when left empty.
create.success: Project created and its source initialized.
create.startHint: Start it from the project list when you are ready.

notFound.title: Project not found
notFound.message: No project with this identifier exists on the AI Factory API. It may have been removed, or the link may be wrong.

error.noCategory: The API reports this as a single text field: it carries no failure category and no time of its own.

start.sourceRequired: The project source has not been initialized yet. A project can only be started once the source step has succeeded.

history.title: Stage history
history.reason: The API reports the current status only. There is no stage history and no stage entry time, so stages are shown by their position relative to the current one and never as completed.

offTrack.repairing: Repair loop. The backend reaches this state from Testing and returns to Testing, so it is not a step forward.
offTrack.paused: Execution is paused. The stage it was paused in is not exposed by the API, so no stage is marked as the current one.
offTrack.failed: Execution ended in failure. The stage it stopped at is not exposed by the API, so no stage is marked as the current one.
offTrack.cancelled: The project was cancelled. The stage it was cancelled in is not exposed by the API, so no stage is marked as the current one.
offTrack.unrecognized: The backend reported a state this client does not recognize, so its position in the lifecycle is unknown.

note.created: The project exists, but no source has been initialized for it yet.
note.notStarted: The project has not been started. The Factory advances it only once it has been started.
note.humanReview: The automated work has finished and human approval is required. Review the evidence below and approve to complete the project.
note.completed: The project is complete. Completed is reachable only through human approval.

source.title: Source
source.notInitializedHelp: No source decision has been recorded for this project yet.
source.emptyHelp: The workspace was created empty; no repository was recorded.

empty.title: No work items
empty.message: This project does not currently expose any work items.

noPlan.title: No dependency plan
noPlan.reason: This project has no accepted plan yet, so work items are listed without dependency order or readiness.

workItem.noDescription: This work item has no description.

detail.title: Work item detail
detail.none: Select a work item to see its detail.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.reason: The API does not yet expose acceptance criteria or results for a work item. A completed status means the backend state is Completed, not that acceptance criteria passed.

error.noCategory: The API reports this as a single text field: it carries no failure category and no time of its own.

empty.title: No agent runs
empty.message: No agent has run for this project yet.

workItemFilter.noMatches: No agent runs are attributed to this work item.

agentRun.noWorkItem: Not attributed to a work item

detail.title: Agent run detail
detail.none: Select an agent run to see its detail.

telemetry.title: Execution telemetry
telemetry.reason: Model, provider and fallback information are persisted by the backend but are not returned by this endpoint. The orchestration run — not yet reachable from this screen — is the only place `selectedModel` is exposed.

structuredResult.title: Structured result
structuredResult.none: No structured result was returned for this run.

noPlan.title: No dependency plan exists for this project
noPlan.reason: Edges are only known once a plan has been accepted. Work items above are shown as a flat list, in no particular order.

present.one: {} dependency issue was found in the plan data and is not shown as an edge.
present.other: {} dependency issues were found in the plan data and are not shown as edges.

humanReview.title: Human Review Required
humanReview.subtitle: Automated processing has reached the human approval gate. Review the available evidence before approving this project.
humanReview.approveButtonSemantics: Approve project — this will transition the project to Completed

confirm.title: Approve project?
confirm.body: This will record your approval and allow the Factory to transition the project to Completed. Review the evidence before continuing.

summary.title: Review Summary
summary.acceptanceUnavailable: Acceptance results are not exposed by the API. A completed work item status does not imply that acceptance criteria passed.

evidence.title: Execution Evidence
evidence.structuredResultsNote: Individual results are shown in the Agent Runs section above.
evidence.telemetryNote: Model, provider and fallback are not exposed by this endpoint (G-RUN-TELEMETRY).

completed.title: Project Completed
completed.body: This project was approved and transitioned to Completed by the backend.

section.failed: This section could not be loaded.
section.empty: The API returned no data for this section.
section.stale: Showing the last values that loaded successfully.

health.title: API health
health.subtitle: What the two health probes answered. This describes the API only.
health.detailUnavailable: The health endpoints answer with a single word of plain text. They name no individual check, so no per-component breakdown can be shown.
health.workerUnavailable: The API exposes no worker health endpoint. Scheduler activity below is the nearest available signal, and it is activity rather than health.

database.title: Database
database.countersDetail: {} retries · {} transient · {} concurrency conflicts · {} busy · {} locked · {} transaction failures
database.migrationsUnavailable: The database endpoint reports provider, readiness and resilience counters. It reports no migration history, and none is inferred here.

scheduler.title: Scheduler activity
scheduler.subtitle: What the dispatch loop did. Not a statement about worker health.
scheduler.noCycleYet: No cycle has run since the service started.
scheduler.notWorkerHealthReason: These are dispatch counters. A cycle count of zero does not mean a worker is down, and a non-zero one does not mean it is healthy — the API exposes no worker health.

metrics.title: Agent metrics
metrics.telemetryUnavailable: This endpoint returns run counters only. Token usage, model cost and provider latency are not exposed, so they are not shown as zero.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.subtitle: Sanitized metadata: flags, names and counts. Never a secret value.
configuration.operationalSecured: Secured — key sent in the {} header
configuration.operationalOpen: Not secured: this deployment serves the operational endpoints without a key.
configuration.noProviders: The configuration endpoint lists no external providers.
configuration.routingUnavailable: Model routing information is unavailable: the API exposes no models, routes or provider-selection endpoints. Provider names above are configuration metadata, not a routing table.

operatorAccess.title: Operator access
operatorAccess.subtitle: The operational API key for this backend. Stored in the platform keystore, never in plain settings.
operatorAccess.keyStored: A key is stored for this device.
operatorAccess.noKey: No key is stored for this device.
operatorAccess.fieldHelp: Issued by whoever operates this AI Factory instance. It is not a model-provider key and never one of your provider credentials.
operatorAccess.storageFailed: The secure keystore could not be read or written. The key was not stored.
operatorAccess.scopeNote: It authorizes the operational, diagnostics and audit endpoints of this API and nothing else. It is sent as a request header, never in a URL, and never written to a log.
operatorAccess.sessionOnly: In the browser the key is kept for this session only: it is never saved, and a reload asks for it again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Operational events recorded by the backend.

filter.clientSideNote: The severity filter narrows the loaded page only. The endpoint accepts a severity parameter but does not apply it, so filtering server-side is not possible.

audit.noMatches: No entry on this page matches the selected severity.

diagnostics.title: Project diagnostics
diagnostics.noDuration: The API reports no execution duration for this project.
diagnostics.staleScopeReason: Stale runs are reported for this project only. The API exposes no system-wide stale count, and summing projects would not produce one.
diagnostics.noWorkItems: The diagnostics response contains no work item counts.
diagnostics.noFailureMessage: The API records a failure time for this project but no message.
diagnostics.acceptanceUnavailable: Acceptance results are not exposed by the API. Work item counts describe backend state, not whether acceptance criteria passed.
diagnostics.unauthorized: This endpoint is protected by the operational key. Enter one below to load the diagnostics.

notFound.title: No diagnostics for this project
notFound.message: The API has no diagnostics record for this project identifier.

status.stopped: Not refreshing automatically — nothing here is changing
